author: DeCombat
description: Case openings spin: before the award window opens, a strip of everything the case can hold runs past a centre mark and slows down until it stops on what you got. Works for supply cases, HiSec cases and the Camo Crate; a click skips to the stop. Drawn on your own screen only: what a case gives is decided by the server before the strip starts, and nothing in play changes.
name: Case Reel
